text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's running was overwhelming... 
The sheer "obsession" she poured into the 
race set her entirely apart from the other 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I run because I cannot afford to lose—" 
Narita Top Road flinched at the sheer 
intensity radiating from Admire Vega, a 
pressure heavier than words alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that at this rate she might not 
win, Narita Top Road resolves once more to 
put in every effort to become even a 
little bit stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the Satsuki Sho... How to 
guide her while she's still an unpolished 
Classic-class runner―― The weight of a 
Trainer's responsibility made the room's 
air feel heavy.
